title: Morning standup docket — high-touch accounts
content:
Morning quick docket — KEISHA
Context: get through high-touch list before noon. Short bullets, triage first then outreach. Rough order: renewals at risk, QBR prep, support follow-ups, action & owners.

PRIORITY ACCOUNTS (quick snapshot)
1) NimbusHealth (renewal 2026-04-05) — RISK: amber
   - Last contact: 2026-03-09 (product sync) — asked for latency reports and cost breakdowns.
   - Immediate: pull per-route token cost + 30/60/90 day latency histogram (Diego) — due EOD 2026-03-13.
   - Prep ask for QBR: one slide on cost optimization opportunities + plan for dedicated reservation options.
   - Outreach script: short call 20m, exec + eng. Ask: confirm renewal cadence, pain w/ burst traffic.

2) AtlasEdu (renewal 2026-05-02) — RISK: green
   - They love the hosted API but want a predictable cadence for class runs. Show Dedicated options.
   - Action: schedule 15-min cost walk-through (Rina) next week; include usage pattern snapshot.

3) MacroRetail (renewal 2026-03-28) — RISK: red
   - Open support tickets: SUP-1128 (rate limit errors), SUP-1130 (KV cache misbehave).
   - Escalation: file incident w/ SRE, tag priority, request WAR room 10:30am today if errors persist.
   - Talking points for renewal: have to commit to SLAs or discuss pause/discount options.

QBR PREP (fast checklist)
- Slides to have by Tue 2026-03-16: 1) Exec summary (1 slide) 2) Usage & cost trend (1 slide) 3) Outages/incidents (1 slide) 4) Roadmap asks + action items (1 slide)
- Collect metrics: daily tokens, p95 latency, error-rate, cost/unit. (Diego owns metrics pull)
- One customer success story/case: ask product for 2 bullet wins (Rina)
- Send draft deck to customer 48h before meeting.

RENEWALS — quick play snippets
- If renewal < 30 days and amber/red -> escalate to AM + offer credits if incident in last 60d.
- If > 30 days -> run Dedicated viability assessment; present 2-year cost delta vs hosted.
- Template email (short):
  "Hi <Name>,
  Quick note — preparing for your upcoming renewal on <date>. Could we schedule 20m to walk through usage, cost, and any concerns? I have a few optimization ideas to share.
  Best, Keisha"

SUPPORT FOLLOW-UPS
- SUP-1128 (MacroRetail) — attach p95 traces, error logs, node IDs. Ask infra to check kernel-level OOM events. Tag #sre-ops.
- SUP-1180 (NimbusHealth) — customer reports token truncation on long prompts. Repro steps requested. Rina to get sample payloads by EOD.

MEETING CHECKLIST (pre-call)
- Confirm attendee list + roles.
- Confirm slide owner and 1-line purpose for each slide.
- Confirm recording/captions enabled.
- Quick pre-call run (5m) w/ internal attendees 10m before meeting.

CALL SCRIPTS (short, use as guardrails)
- Opening 30s: "Thanks for your time — quick health check, then we have two suggestions we think will reduce unit cost and smooth latency spikes."
- If the customer raises incidents: "Totally understand. Here are the facts we have, immediate mitigations we can apply, and timeline for root-cause follow-up."
- Close: "We’ll follow with a one-pager with next steps and owners within 24 hours."

NOTES TO SELF (scratch)
- Get comparison matrix: hosted vs dedicated vs private for MacroRetail (cost + SLA + infra ops).
- Capture any ask that needs legal (data retention / audit) -> flag for Security.
- Remember to update weekly CS scoreboard with renewal velocity.

OPEN QUESTIONS
- NimbusHealth: want custom tokenization support? (need product confirm if feasible Q2)
- MacroRetail: how many concurrent inference streams in peak? need exact number for capacity plan.

END-OF-MORNING ACTIONS (target by 12:00)
- Send MacroRetail escalation note + tag SRE (Keisha).
- Collect NimbusHealth samples & cost graphs (Diego).
- Draft QBR slide skeleton and share with Rina (Keisha).

RANDOM REMINDERS
- Check #billing for any new invoices flagged unpaid.
- Add a short anecdote to QBR: 1 line about cost-savings from caching change last month.

---
Scratch style — will tidy before uploading to Confluence. If run out of time, prioritize MacroRetail + SUP-1128 escalation.
